Solve \( \ln(3x) = 5 \), giving your answer as an exact value.
Solve \( 4\ln(2x - 1) = 12 \), giving your answer as an exact value.
Solve \( e^{3x} = 27 \), giving your answer in terms of \( \ln 3 \).
Solve \( e^{2x - 1} = 9 \), giving your answer in terms of \( \ln 3 \).
Solve \( \ln 5 + \ln x = 7 \), giving your answer as an exact value.
Solve \( \ln(4x) + \ln(3x) = 10 \), giving your answer as an exact value.
Solve \( 3\ln x + 5\ln x = 2 \), giving your answer as an exact value.
Find the exact solutions of \( e^{2x} - 5e^x + 6 = 0 \).
Find the exact solutions of \( e^{2x} - 7e^x + 12 = 0 \).
Find the exact solutions of \( 2e^{2x} - 7e^x + 3 = 0 \).
Find the exact solutions of \( 3e^{2x} + 10e^x + 3 = 0 \).
Solve simultaneously: \( 3^x = 9^y \) and \( 2x + y = 5 \).
Solve simultaneously: \( \log_2 x = 1 + \log_2 y \) and \( x = 3y - 4 \).

A population of rabbits is modelled by \( P = 120e^{0.04t} \), where \( P \) is the population and \( t \) is the time in years.

 (a) Find the initial population.

 (b) Find the value of \( t \) when the population reaches 300. Give your answer to 3 s.f.

The temperature \( T \) (°C) of a cooling drink is modelled by \( T = 80e^{-0.05t} + 20 \), where \( t \) is the time in minutes.

 (a) State the initial temperature.

 (b) Find the time at which the drink reaches 40°C. Give your answer to 3 s.f.

(a) Show that the equation \( e^{2x} - 4e^x = 5 \) can be written as \( (e^x - 5)(e^x + 1) = 0 \).

 (b) Hence solve \( e^{2x} - 4e^x = 5 \), giving any exact solutions.

(a) Show that \( \log_3(x+6) - \log_3 x = 2 \) leads to \( 9x = x + 6 \).

 (b) Hence solve \( \log_3(x+6) - \log_3 x = 2 \), giving your answer as an exact value.

The value \( V \) (£) of a car after \( t \) years is modelled by \( V = 18000 \times 0.85^t \).

 (a) Write down the initial value of the car.

 (b) Find the number of complete years for the car to first be worth less than £6000.

(a) Solve \( \ln(x^2 - 2x) = \ln(8 - x^2) \).

 (b) Verify that both solutions are valid by checking that the logarithm arguments are positive.
Solve \( 3^x = 7 \). Give your answer to 3 s.f.
Solve \( e^{3x} = 20 \). Give exact answer.
Solve \( \log_3 x + \log_3(x + 6) = 3 \).
Solve \( 7^x = 3^{x+2} \). Give answer to 3 s.f.
Solve \( 2 \times 3^x = 5 \times 2^x \). Give answer to 3 s.f.
A population grows according to \( P = 500e^{0.03t} \). Find \( t \) when \( P = 1000 \).
Solve \( \ln x + \ln(x - 2) = \ln 15 \).
The half-life of a substance is 10 hours. If \( m = m_0 e^{-kt} \), find \( k \).
Solve \( 2\log_3 x = \log_3(5x + 6) \).
Solve \( 3^{x+1} = 4^{x-1} \). Give answer to 3 s.f.
Solve \( \log(x + 5) + \log(x - 2) = \log 18 \). (Base 10)
Solve \( \ln(x^2) = 6 \).
An investment of \( \pounds 2000 \) grows to \( \pounds 3000 \) at 4% compound interest. Find the number of years.
Solve simultaneously: \( \log_2 x + \log_2 y = 5 \) and \( \log_2 x - \log_2 y = 1 \).
Solve \( (\log x)^2 = \log x^4 \). (Base 10)
Solve \( 2\ln(x + 1) - \ln x = \ln 4 \).
A cooling object has temperature \( T = 25 + 60e^{-0.04t} \). Find when \( T = 40 \).
Find the exact solution of \( 3^x = 2 \times 5^x \).

el5.questionText:
A colony of bacteria is modelled by \( B = 200e^{0.05t} \), where \( B \) is the number of bacteria and \( t \) is the time in hours.

 (a) Write down the initial number of bacteria.

 (b) Predict the number of bacteria after 10 hours. Give your answer to the nearest whole number.

The mass \( M \) (grams) of a radioactive sample after \( t \) years is given by \( M = 500e^{-0.03t} \).

 (a) State the initial mass.

 (b) Find the mass remaining after 20 years. Give your answer to 3 significant figures.

An oven is preheating. Its temperature \( T\,^\circ\!\text{C} \) after \( t \) minutes is given by \( T = 220 - 200e^{-0.1t} \).

 (a) What was the initial temperature of the oven?

 (b) What is the temperature after 8 minutes? Give your answer to 3 s.f.

The value \( V \) (£) of a motorbike \( t \) years after purchase is modelled by \( V = 8000e^{-0.15t} \).

 (a) State the purchase price.

 (b) Find the value after 4 years. Give your answer to the nearest pound.

A savings account earns compound interest. The amount \( A \) (£) after \( t \) years is modelled by \( A = 2500 \times 1.04^t \).

 (a) Write down the initial amount invested.

 (b) Find the amount in the account after 6 years. Give your answer to the nearest penny.

A drug concentration \( C \) (mg/litre) in a patient's bloodstream after \( t \) hours is modelled by \( C = 4e^{-0.2t} \).

 (a) State the initial concentration.

 (b) Find the concentration after 3 hours. Give your answer to 3 s.f.

A population of insects is modelled by \( P = 150e^{0.06t} \), where \( t \) is the time in days.

 Find the value of \( t \) when the population first reaches 500. Give your answer to 3 significant figures.

The mass \( M \) grams of a substance decays according to \( M = 800e^{-0.04t} \), where \( t \) is in years.

 Find the time taken for the mass to reduce to 200 g. Give your answer to 3 s.f.

A savings account is modelled by \( A = 1000 \times 1.025^t \), where \( A \) is the amount (£) and \( t \) is the number of years.

 Find the number of complete years required for the account to exceed £1500.

A car depreciates in value according to \( V = 12000 \times 0.88^t \), where \( V \) is the value (£) and \( t \) is the time in years.

 Find the number of complete years before the car is worth less than £5000.

A drug concentration \( C \) mg/litre decays according to \( C = 8e^{-0.35t} \), where \( t \) is in hours.

 Find the time at which the concentration first falls below 1 mg/litre. Give your answer to 3 s.f.

An oven cools after being switched off. Its temperature \( T\,^\circ\!\text{C} \) after \( t \) minutes satisfies \( T = 180e^{-0.08t} + 20 \).

 Find the time for the oven to cool to 60°C. Give your answer to 3 s.f.

The number of views \( V \) of a viral video after \( t \) days is modelled by \( V = 500 \times 3^t \).

 Find the number of complete days before the video exceeds 1 000 000 views.

A population \( P \) of rabbits is modelled by \( P = Ae^{kt} \). Initially there are 80 rabbits. After 5 years there are 200 rabbits.

 Find the values of \( A \) and \( k \). Give \( k \) to 3 s.f.

The mass \( M \) grams of a substance decays according to \( M = Ae^{kt} \). The initial mass is 600 g and after 10 years the mass is 350 g.

 Find \( A \) and \( k \). Give \( k \) to 3 s.f.

A fungus grows according to \( F = F_0 e^{gt} \). Initially it covers 3 mm². After 8 hours it covers 18 mm².

 (a) Find \( F_0 \) and \( g \). Give \( g \) to 3 s.f.

 (b) Predict the area covered after 15 hours.

The number of users \( N \) of a new app after \( t \) months satisfies \( N = N_0 e^{kt} \). After 2 months there are 5000 users and after 6 months there are 25000 users.

 Find the values of \( N_0 \) and \( k \). Give your answers to 3 s.f.

A radioactive substance has a half-life of 15 years. Its decay is modelled by \( A = A_0 e^{kt} \).

 (a) Show that \( k = -\dfrac{\ln 2}{15} \).

 (b) Find the value of \( k \) to 3 s.f.

A radioactive substance has a half-life of 20 years and an initial activity of 640 Bq. Its activity is modelled by \( A = A_0 e^{kt} \).

 (a) Find \( k \) to 3 s.f.

 (b) Find the activity after 30 years.

 (c) After how many years does the activity first fall below 50 Bq? Give your answer to 3 s.f.

A substance has a half-life of 8 years. The initial activity is 1000 Bq.

 After how many years is the substance reduced to a quarter of its original activity?

The temperature \( T\,^\circ\!\text{C} \) of a room \( t \) minutes after the heating is turned on is modelled by \( T = 22 - 16e^{-0.05t} \).

 (a) State the initial temperature of the room.

 (b) Explain what happens to \( T \) as \( t \to \infty \).

 (c) Explain why this model has an upper limit and state what it is.

The penguin population \( P \) of an island is modelled by \( P = 3000e^{0.02t} \), where \( t \) is the number of years after a survey.

 (a) State the initial population.

 (b) Explain why this model may not be appropriate for large values of \( t \).

A car's value (£) \( t \) years after purchase is modelled by \( V = 2000 + 11000e^{-0.2t} \).

 (a) State the purchase price.

 (b) Explain the significance of the value 2000 in the model.

 (c) After how many complete years is the car worth less than £4000? Give your answer to 3 s.f.

A forest fire spreads so that the burnt area \( H \) hectares after \( t \) hours satisfies \( H = 10e^{bt} \).

 (a) Interpret the value 10 in this model.

 (b) After 2 hours the burnt area is 40 hectares. Find the value of \( b \).

 (c) Find the area burned after 5 hours. Give your answer to 3 s.f.
Describe one limitation of using the model \( H = 10e^{0.693t} \) to predict the area burned by a forest fire over a long period.

Two populations of bacteria are modelled by \( B_1 = 400e^{0.03t} \) and \( B_2 = 100e^{0.08t} \), where \( t \) is in hours.

 (a) Which population is larger initially?

 (b) Find the time at which both populations are equal. Give your answer to 3 s.f.

Two cars depreciate as follows: Car A: \( V = 20000e^{-0.1t} \); Car B: \( V = 15000e^{-0.06t} \), where \( t \) is in years.

 (a) Which car costs more initially?

 (b) After how many years are both cars worth the same amount? Give your answer to 3 s.f.

A population of fish is modelled by \( P = 600e^{0.04t} \), where \( t \) is in years.

 (a) Find the rate of growth \( \dfrac{\mathrm{d}P}{\mathrm{d}t} \) in terms of \( t \).

 (b) Evaluate the rate of growth when \( t = 5 \). Give your answer to 3 s.f.

 (c) Show that the rate of growth is proportional to the population.

A radioactive substance decays according to \( M = 250e^{-0.05t} \) grams, where \( t \) is in years.

 (a) Find the rate of decay \( \dfrac{\mathrm{d}M}{\mathrm{d}t} \).

 (b) Find the rate of decay when \( t = 10 \). Give your answer to 3 s.f.

£500 is invested in an account paying 2.5% compound interest per year. No further deposits or withdrawals are made.

 (a) Write a model for the amount \( A \) (£) in the account after \( t \) years.

 (b) Find the amount after 10 years. Give your answer to the nearest penny.

 (c) Find the number of complete years before the account holds more than £800.

A patient is given a dose of medicine. The concentration \( C \) mg/litre in their bloodstream after \( t \) hours satisfies \( C = Ae^{kt} \). Initially the concentration is 5 mg/litre. After 4 hours it is 2 mg/litre.

 (a) Find \( A \) and \( k \). Give \( k \) to 3 s.f.

 (b) Find the concentration after 6 hours. Give your answer to 3 s.f.

 (c) The medicine is effective when \( C \geq 0.5 \) mg/litre. Find the length of time for which the medicine is effective.

A radioactive isotope has a half-life of 25 years. A sample initially has an activity of 480 Bq. The activity is modelled by \( A = 480e^{kt} \).

 (a) Show that \( k = -\dfrac{\ln 2}{25} \).

 (b) Find the activity after 50 years.

 (c) Find the original activity if the activity after 10 years is 300 Bq. Give your answer to 3 s.f.

A town's population \( P \) is modelled by \( P = 45000e^{0.012t} \), where \( t \) is the number of years after 2020.

 (a) Estimate the population in 2030.

 (b) Estimate the year in which the population first exceeds 60 000.

 (c) Give one reason why the model may not be reliable in the long term.

The number of subscribers \( S \) to a YouTube channel after \( t \) weeks satisfies \( S = S_0 e^{kt} \). After 3 weeks there are 8000 subscribers and after 9 weeks there are 50000 subscribers.

 (a) Find \( S_0 \) and \( k \). Give \( k \) to 3 s.f.

 (b) Predict the number of subscribers after 15 weeks.

 (c) Describe one limitation of this model.

A Newton's Law of Cooling model gives the temperature \( T\,^\circ\!\text{C} \) of a hot drink after \( t \) minutes as \( T = 65e^{-0.04t} + 20 \).

 (a) State the initial temperature.

 (b) Find the temperature after 10 minutes. Give your answer to 3 s.f.

 (c) Find the time at which the drink cools to 35°C. Give your answer to 3 s.f.

 (d) Explain what the value 20 represents and state the long-term behaviour of \( T \).
A colony of bacteria doubles every 4 hours. Starting with 200, find the population after 20 hours.
A radioactive substance has half-life 5 years. If the initial mass is 80 g, find the mass after 15 years.
A population is modelled by \( P = 1000e^{0.05t} \). Find: (a) the initial population; (b) the population after 10 years.
The mass of a substance decays according to \( m = 50e^{-0.1t} \). Find when the mass is 25 g.
A car depreciates at 15% per year. Its initial value is \( \pounds 20000 \). Find its value after 5 years.
An investment grows at 3% compound interest per year. How long until it doubles?
The temperature of a cooling body is \( T = 15 + 70e^{-0.03t} \). Find the initial temperature and the temperature after 30 minutes.
A population of 5000 increases at 2% per year. Write a model and find the population after 20 years.
A substance decays so that \( m = m_0 e^{-kt} \). After 8 hours, 75% remains. Find \( k \).
The number of fish in a lake is modelled by \( N = \frac{2000}{1 + 9e^{-0.5t}} \). Find: (a) N when t = 0; (b) N as t approaches infinity.
Carbon-14 has a half-life of 5730 years. A sample has 40% of its original C-14. How old is it?
A drug is eliminated from the body so that the amount \( A \) mg after \( t \) hours is \( A = 400e^{-0.2t} \). Find when less than 50 mg remains.
The value of a painting increases according to \( V = 500e^{0.08t} \). Find: (a) the value after 10 years; (b) when it reaches \( \pounds 2000 \).
A cup of tea cools from \( 90^\circ \)C in a room at \( 20^\circ \)C. After 5 minutes it is \( 70^\circ \)C. Find \( k \) in \( T = 20 + 70e^{-kt} \).
The spread of a rumour is modelled by \( N = 500(1 - e^{-0.1t}) \) where \( N \) is the number who have heard it after \( t \) hours. Find: (a) N after 5 hours; (b) when 400 people have heard it.
A machine loses 12% of its value each year. After how many years is it worth less than a quarter of its original value?
The pressure \( P \) at height \( h \) km is modelled by \( P = 101e^{-0.12h} \). Find the pressure at 10 km.
The number of cases of a disease grows according to \( N = 50e^{0.15t} \). How long until there are 500 cases?
Show that if \( y = Ae^{kt} \), then \( \ln y \) is a linear function of \( t \). State the gradient and y-intercept.
A capacitor discharges: \( V = 12e^{-t/RC} \) where \( R = 1000 \), \( C = 0.001 \). Find \( V \) after 2 seconds.
A town has population 8000 growing at 1.5% per year. In how many years will it exceed 10000?
Two populations: \( P_1 = 3000e^{0.02t} \) and \( P_2 = 5000e^{-0.01t} \). When are they equal?
A lake contains 100 kg of pollutant. Each year 20% is removed naturally. How long until less than 10 kg remains?
The temperature of a freezer item placed in a room is \( T = 22 - 40e^{-0.05t} \). Find when T = 10.
A savings account pays 5% interest compounded annually. Find the annual equivalent rate if compounded continuously.
A rumour spreads so that after \( t \) hours, the fraction who know is \( f = 1 - e^{-0.3t} \). After how many hours do 90% know?
Light intensity decreases with depth: \( I = I_0 e^{-0.4d} \) where \( d \) is in metres. At what depth is the intensity 1% of the surface value?
The rate of decay of a substance is proportional to the amount present. Write the differential equation and its solution.
House prices increase by 6% per year. A house costs \( \pounds 200000 \) now. What will it cost in 8 years?
The charge on a capacitor builds up: \( Q = Q_0(1 - e^{-t/RC}) \). If \( Q_0 = 100 \), \( RC = 5 \), find Q after 10 seconds.
Data suggests \( y = ab^x \). When \( x = 0, y = 3 \) and when \( x = 4, y = 48 \). Find \( a \) and \( b \).
A ball bounces to 80% of its previous height. Dropped from 2 m, after how many bounces is it below 0.5 m?
Show that a quantity with constant percentage growth rate \( r\% \) per unit time can be written as \( Q = Q_0 e^{kt} \) where \( k = \ln(1 + r/100) \).
Bacteria grow from 100 to 300 in 6 hours. Assuming exponential growth \( N = 100e^{kt} \), find: (a) k; (b) the population after 10 hours.
A radioactive element has decay constant \( k = 0.005 \) per year. Find: (a) the half-life; (b) the time for 90% to decay; (c) the percentage remaining after 100 years.

el6.questionText:
A relationship between \( x \) and \( y \) is believed to follow \( y = ax^n \).

 Show that taking \( \log_{10} \) of both sides gives a straight-line equation of the form \( \log y = n\log x + \log a \), and state what the gradient and vertical intercept represent.

A straight-line graph is obtained by plotting \( \log_{10} y \) against \( \log_{10} x \). The gradient is 3 and the vertical intercept is 0.5.

 Find the values of \( a \) and \( n \) in the relationship \( y = ax^n \).

A graph of \( \log_{10} y \) against \( \log_{10} x \) passes through the points \( (0, 1.2) \) and \( (2, 3.2) \).

 Find the values of \( a \) and \( n \) in the equation \( y = ax^n \).

A graph of \( \log_{10} y \) against \( \log_{10} x \) passes through \( (1, 2.6) \) and \( (3, 4.0) \).

 Find \( a \) and \( n \) in \( y = ax^n \). Give your answers to 3 s.f.

The table below shows values of \( x \) and \( y \) that are thought to satisfy \( y = ax^n \).

\(\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|c|}\hline x & 4 & 9 & 16 & 25 \\ \hline y & 24 & 81 & 192 & 375 \\ \hline \end{array}\)

By plotting \( \log y \) against \( \log x \), find \( a \) and \( n \).

The radius \( r \) cm and height \( h \) cm of several cylinders are thought to satisfy \( h = ar^n \). A graph of \( \log h \) against \( \log r \) gives a straight line with gradient \( -2 \) and vertical intercept \( 3 \).

 Write down the relationship between \( h \) and \( r \).

A relationship between \( x \) and \( y \) is believed to follow \( y = kb^x \).

 Show that taking \( \log_{10} \) of both sides gives a straight-line equation of the form \( \log y = x\log b + \log k \), and state what the gradient and vertical intercept represent.

A graph of \( \log_{10} y \) against \( x \) is a straight line with gradient \( 0.3 \) and vertical intercept \( 1.7 \).

 Find the values of \( k \) and \( b \) in the equation \( y = kb^x \). Give your answers to 3 s.f.

A graph of \( \log_{10} y \) against \( x \) passes through the points \( (0, 2) \) and \( (5, 3.5) \).

 Find \( k \) and \( b \) in \( y = kb^x \). Give your answers to 3 s.f.

A graph of \( \log_{10} y \) against \( x \) passes through \( (2, 1.4) \) and \( (6, 2.8) \).

 Find \( k \) and \( b \) in \( y = kb^x \). Give your answers to 3 s.f.

The equation \( y = kb^x \) can also be written as \( y = ke^{cx} \) for some constant \( c \).

 A graph of \( \ln y \) against \( x \) has gradient \( 0.4 \) and vertical intercept \( 3 \).

 Write down the values of \( k \) and \( c \) in \( y = ke^{cx} \).

A graph of \( \ln y \) against \( x \) passes through \( (0, 1.5) \) and \( (4, 3.9) \).

 Find \( k \) and \( c \) in \( y = ke^{cx} \). Give your answers to 3 s.f.

The table below gives values of \( t \) and \( y \) which satisfy \( y = kb^t \).



 \(\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|c|}\hline t & 1 & 3 & 5 & 7 \\\hline y & 6 & 30 & 150 & 750 \\\hline\end{array}\)



 (a) Copy and complete the table of \( \log_{10} y \) values.

 (b) State the gradient and vertical intercept of the graph of \( \log y \) against \( t \).

 (c) Hence find \( k \) and \( b \).

The table below gives values of \( x \) and \( y \) which satisfy \( y = ax^n \).



 \(\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|c|}\hline x & 2 & 4 & 8 & 16 \\\hline y & 12 & 34 & 96 & 271 \\\hline\end{array}\)



 (a) Complete the table of \( \log x \) and \( \log y \) values.

 (b) Find the gradient and vertical intercept of \( \log y \) against \( \log x \).

 (c) Find \( a \) and \( n \) to 3 s.f.

The activity \( x \) (Bq) of a radioactive substance at time \( t \) (days) satisfies \( x = kb^t \). The measurements are:



 \(\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|c|}\hline t & 10 & 20 & 40 & 80 \\\hline x & 500 & 250 & 62.5 & 15.6 \\\hline\end{array}\)



 (a) Find \( \log_{10} x \) for each value of \( t \).

 (b) Plot \( \log x \) against \( t \) and draw a line of best fit.

 (c) Find \( k \) and \( b \). Give your answers to 3 s.f.

A graph of \( \log y \) against \( \log x \) gives a straight line with equation \( \log y = 2\log x + 0.6 \).

 (a) Find \( y \) when \( x = 5 \).

 (b) Find \( x \) when \( y = 200 \). Give your answers to 3 s.f.

A graph of \( \log y \) against \( x \) gives the equation \( \log y = 0.2x + 1.3 \).

 (a) Find \( y \) when \( x = 3 \).

 (b) Find \( x \) when \( y = 1000 \). Give your answers to 3 s.f.

The number of subscribers \( S \) to a blog after \( t \) weeks satisfies \( S = at^b \). A graph of \( \log S \) against \( \log t \) is a straight line passing through \( (0.5, 2.1) \) and \( (1.5, 3.3) \).

 (a) Find \( a \) and \( b \).

 (b) Predict the number of subscribers after 20 weeks.

The value £\( V \) of a machine \( t \) years after purchase satisfies \( V = pq^t \). A graph of \( \log V \) against \( t \) passes through \( (0, 4.3) \) and \( (10, 3.1) \).

 (a) Find \( p \) and \( q \) to 3 s.f.

 (b) Find the value of the machine after 7 years.

The pressure \( P \) (Pa) and volume \( V \) (m³) of a gas satisfy \( P = kV^n \). A graph of \( \log P \) against \( \log V \) has gradient \( -1.4 \) and passes through the point \( (0.5, 3.8) \).

 (a) Find \( k \) and \( n \).

 (b) Find \( P \) when \( V = 0.2 \). Give your answer to 3 s.f.

The relationship between \( x \) and \( y \) is \( y = 5 \times 4^x \).

 (a) Show that a graph of \( \log y \) against \( x \) will be a straight line.

 (b) State the gradient and vertical intercept of this straight line.

The height \( h \) (m) and mass \( m \) (kg) of several trees satisfy \( h = 2m^{0.4} \).

 (a) Write the equation in linear form suitable for plotting \( \log h \) against \( \log m \).

 (b) State the gradient and vertical intercept.

 (c) Describe the graph of \( h \) against \( m \).

A tank is being filled with water. After \( s \) seconds the height \( h \) mm of water satisfies \( h = 3 \times 2^s \).

 (a) Write this in linear form for a graph of \( \log h \) against \( s \).

 (b) Explain which graph — \( h \) against \( s \) or \( \log h \) against \( s \) — is more useful for calculations.

The population \( p \) of bacteria after \( t \) hours satisfies \( p = 50e^{0.3t} \).

 (a) Write this in linear form for a graph of \( \ln p \) against \( t \).

 (b) State the gradient and vertical intercept of the straight-line graph.

Two populations are modelled by \( \ln P \) against \( t \) graphs.

 Population A: \( \ln P = 0.2t + 4 \)

 Population B: \( \ln P = -0.1t + 7 \)

 (a) Find the time \( t \) when the populations are equal.

 (b) Find the common population at this time. Give your answer to 3 s.f.

Two rival blogs have subscriber counts modelled as follows (where \( t \) is days):

 Blog A (growing): \( \log S = 0.08t + 2 \)

 Blog B (declining): \( \log S = -0.04t + 3.5 \)

 (a) Find the number of subscribers each blog starts with.

 (b) Find the day on which both blogs have the same number of subscribers.

Two animal populations on an island are modelled by \( \ln N \) against \( t \) (years) graphs:

 Deer: \( \ln N = 0.15t + 5 \)

 Wolves: \( \ln N = 0.25t + 3 \)

 (a) Find the initial population of each species.

 (b) Find the year \( t \) when the wolf population overtakes the deer population.

 (c) Find the combined population at this point. Give your answer to the nearest whole number.

A graph of \( \log y \) against \( \log x \) is a straight line passing through \( (0.4, 1.0) \) and \( (1.2, 2.6) \).

 (a) Find the equation of the line.

 (b) Hence write down the equation relating \( y \) and \( x \) in the form \( y = ax^n \).

 (c) Find \( y \) when \( x = 50 \). Give your answer to 3 s.f.

A model \( y = 10 \times 3^x \) is used to predict the number of users \( y \) of a social network after \( x \) months.

 (a) Write the model in the form \( \log y = mx + c \).

 (b) Describe one limitation of this model over a long time period.

A student plots \( \log y \) against \( \log x \) for a data set and obtains a straight line. They conclude the data follows \( y = ax^n \).

 Another student plots \( \log y \) against \( x \) for the same data and also obtains a straight line. They conclude the data follows \( y = kb^x \).

 (a) Explain how both students can be correct.

 (b) Describe how you would distinguish between the two models experimentally.

The number of employees \( p \) in a company \( t \) years after it was founded is modelled by \( p = at^b \). The table of values below is given:



 \(\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|c|c|}\hline t & 2 & 5 & 10 & 20 & 40 \\\hline p & 15 & 28 & 45 & 72 & 114 \\\hline\end{array}\)



 (a) Copy and complete a table of \( \log t \) and \( \log p \) values to 3 d.p.

 (b) Plot a linear graph and draw a line of best fit.

 (c) Find the values of \( a \) and \( b \).

 (d) Predict the number of employees after 60 years.

The value £\( V \) of a piece of equipment \( t \) years old is modelled by \( V = pq^t \). A graph of \( \log V \) against \( t \) has gradient \( -\frac{1}{5} \) and passes through \( (0, 4) \).

 (a) Find \( p \) and \( q \) to 3 s.f.

 (b) Find the age at which the equipment is worth less than £1000.

 (c) Write an equation for the linear graph and state the axes that should be plotted.

The number of bacteria \( p \) (in thousands) in a petri dish after \( t \) days satisfies \( p = at^b \). Observations give:



 \(\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|c|}\hline t & 1 & 3 & 6 & 9 \\\hline p & 2 & 14 & 44 & 88 \\\hline\end{array}\)



 (a) Plot a linear graph of \( \log p \) against \( \log t \) using the data.

 (b) Find \( a \) and \( b \) to 3 s.f.

 (c) Predict the number of bacteria after 15 days.

 (d) Describe one reason why the model may not be appropriate after many days.

A scientist measures the speed \( v \) (m/s) of a chemical reaction at temperature \( T \) (K). She believes \( v = aT^n \). A graph of \( \log v \) against \( \log T \) gives a straight line with equation \( \log v = 2.5\log T - 5.4 \).

 (a) Find \( a \) and \( n \) to 3 s.f.

 (b) Find \( v \) when \( T = 400 \) K.

 (c) Find \( T \) when \( v = 80 \). Give your answer to 3 s.f.

The populations (in thousands) of rabbits \( R \) and foxes \( F \) on an island are modelled by straight-line graphs of \( \ln N \) against \( t \) (years):

 Rabbits: \( \ln R = -0.08t + 8 \)

 Foxes: \( \ln F = 0.12t + 4 \)

 (a) Find the initial population of each species. Give your answers to 3 s.f.

 (b) Find the year \( t \) when both populations are equal.

 (c) Find the combined population at this time. Give your answer to 3 s.f.

 (d) Explain why the rabbit model may not be appropriate for large \( t \).
A graph of \( \log y \) against \( \log x \) is a straight line with gradient 2 and y-intercept 0.5. Write down the equation connecting \( y \) and \( x \).
A graph of \( \log y \) against \( x \) is a straight line with gradient 0.2 and y-intercept 1. Find \( k \) and \( b \) in \( y = kb^x \).
Explain why plotting \( \log y \) against \( \log x \) for data following \( y = ax^n \) gives a straight line.
Explain why plotting \( \log y \) against \( x \) for data following \( y = kb^x \) gives a straight line.
A graph of \( \ln y \) against \( x \) has gradient 0.5 and passes through \( (0, 2) \). Find the equation in the form \( y = ke^{cx} \).
A graph of \( \log y \) against \( \log x \) passes through \( (0.5, 1.2) \) and \( (2.0, 3.0) \). Find \( a \) and \( n \) in \( y = ax^n \).
A graph of \( \log y \) against \( x \) passes through \( (0, 1.5) \) and \( (4, 3.5) \). Find \( k \) and \( b \) in \( y = kb^x \).
Data: \( x = 2, y = 20 \); \( x = 5, y = 125 \). Verify these satisfy \( y = ax^n \) and find \( a \) and \( n \).
Data: \( x = 1, y = 6 \); \( x = 3, y = 54 \). These satisfy \( y = kb^x \). Find \( k \) and \( b \).
The equation \( \log y = 0.3x + 1.2 \) relates \( x \) and \( y \). Find \( y \) when \( x = 5 \).
The equation \( \log y = 1.5\log x + 0.8 \) relates \( x \) and \( y \). Find \( y \) when \( x = 4 \).
Given \( \ln y = 2x + 3 \), express \( y \) in the form \( y = Ae^{Bx} \).
A straight line on a \( \log y \) vs \( \log x \) graph has equation \( \log y = -2\log x + 3 \). Write \( y \) as a function of \( x \).
A relationship \( y = 3 \times 2^x \) is plotted as \( \log y \) against \( x \). Find the gradient and y-intercept of the resulting line.
A relationship \( y = 5x^3 \) is plotted as \( \log y \) against \( \log x \). Find the gradient and y-intercept.
A student plots \( \log y \) against \( \log x \) and gets gradient 0.5 and intercept 1. What is the relationship?
A student plots \( \log y \) against \( x \) and gets a straight line. Another plots \( \log y \) against \( \log x \) and gets a curve. What type of relationship does the data follow?
Given the line \( \log y = -0.5\log x + 2 \), find \( x \) when \( y = 50 \).
Given \( \log y = 0.4x + 0.8 \), find \( x \) when \( y = 1000 \).
The speed \( v \) and distance \( d \) of planets satisfy \( v = kd^n \). A plot of \( \log v \) against \( \log d \) gives gradient \( -0.5 \) and intercept \( 2.1 \). Find \( k \) and \( n \).
A relationship \( y = 4e^{-0.3x} \) is plotted as \( \ln y \) against \( x \). State the gradient and intercept.
Two points on a \( \ln y \) vs \( x \) graph are \( (2, 3.4) \) and \( (8, 6.4) \). Find \( k \) and \( c \) in \( y = ke^{cx} \).
A decay process has data: \( t = 0, y = 100 \); \( t = 10, y = 37 \). Find the equation \( y = Ae^{-kt} \).
Which graph type would you plot to test if data follows: (a) \( y = ax^n \); (b) \( y = kb^x \); (c) \( y = ke^{cx} \)?
A graph of \( \log y \) against \( \log x \) gives gradient 3 and passes through \( (1, 2) \). Find the equation and evaluate \( y \) when \( x = 10 \).
Convert \( y = 7 \times 5^x \) into the form \( \log y = mx + c \) and state \( m \) and \( c \).
Convert \( y = 8x^{2.5} \) into the form \( \log y = n\log x + \log a \) and state \( n \) and \( \log a \).
The line \( \log y = 2\log x + 0.3 \) intersects the line \( \log y = 3 \). Find the value of \( x \) at the intersection.
A graph of \( \log P \) against \( \log V \) for a gas gives a straight line with gradient \( -1.4 \) and intercept 2.5. Find \( P \) when \( V = 10 \).
A graph of \( \log y \) against \( x \) has equation \( \log y = -0.15x + 4 \). Find the half-life (when y = half initial value).
Show that \( y = 2x^3 \) and \( y = 8x \) intersect when \( x = 2 \) by using logarithmic methods.

The time \( t \) (s) for a pendulum to swing depends on length \( l \) (m): \( t = al^n \). A plot of \( \log t \) vs \( \log l \) gives gradient 0.5 and intercept 0.3. Find \( a \) and \( n \), and find \( t \) when \( l = 4 \).
A graph of \( \ln N \) against \( t \) has equation \( \ln N = 0.2t + 5 \). Find: (a) the initial value; (b) the doubling time.
Two models are proposed for data: Model A \( y = ax^n \) and Model B \( y = kb^x \). Plotting \( \log y \) vs \( \log x \) gives a curve but \( \log y \) vs \( x \) gives a line. Which model fits?

A graph of \( \log y \) against \( \log x \) passes through \( (0, 1.5) \) and \( (2, 4.5) \). Find the equation \( y = ax^n \), then find: (a) \( y \) when \( x = 100 \); (b) \( x \) when \( y = 1000 \).
Sketch the curve \( y = e^{x} \), labelling the \( y \)-intercept and any asymptote.
Sketch the curve \( y = \ln x \), labelling the \( x \)-intercept and any asymptote.
On the same axes, sketch \( y = e^{x} \) and \( y = e^{-x} \). State the relationship between the two curves.
Sketch the curve \( y = e^{x} - 1 \), labelling the \( x \)- and \( y \)-intercepts and the asymptote.
Sketch the curve \( y = \ln(x + 2) \), labelling the \( x \)-intercept, \( y \)-intercept and any asymptote.
Sketch the curve \( y = 2^{x} \), labelling the \( y \)-intercept and any asymptote.
Sketch the curve \( y = \log_{10} x \), labelling the \( x \)-intercept and any asymptote.
Sketch the curve \( y = -e^{x} \), labelling the \( y \)-intercept and any asymptote.
Sketch the curve \( y = e^{2x} \), labelling the \( y \)-intercept and any asymptote. Compare its steepness with \( y = e^{x} \) at \( x = 1 \).
Sketch the curve \( y = e^{x} + 2 \), labelling the \( y \)-intercept and any asymptote.
Sketch the curve \( y = e^{-x} + 1 \), labelling the \( y \)-intercept and any asymptote.
Sketch the curve \( y = \ln(2x) \), labelling the \( x \)-intercept and any asymptote.
Sketch the curve \( y = \ln x + 1 \), labelling the \( x \)-intercept and any asymptote.
Sketch the curve \( y = \ln(-x) \), stating its domain and labelling any asymptote and intercept.
Sketch the curve \( y = 3 - e^{x} \), labelling the \( x \)- and \( y \)-intercepts and the asymptote.
Sketch the curve \( y = e^{x - 1} \), labelling the \( y \)-intercept and any asymptote.
Sketch the curve \( y = \ln(x - 1) \), labelling the \( x \)-intercept and any asymptote.
Sketch the curve \( y = 2\ln x \), labelling the \( x \)-intercept and any asymptote. Compare with \( y = \ln x \) at \( x = e \).
Sketch the curve \( y = 2^{-x} \), labelling the \( y \)-intercept and any asymptote.
On the same axes, sketch \( y = \ln x \) and \( y = \log_{10} x \). Which curve climbs faster and why?

ga01.questionText: Write \(a \times a \times a\) using index notation.
Write \(5 \times y\) without using a multiplication sign.
Write \(p \div q\) as a fraction.
Write \(n + n + n + n\) using a coefficient.
Write \(a \times b\) without a multiplication sign, in the correct order.
Write \(x \times x\) using index notation.
Write \(3 \times m\) in correct algebraic notation.
Write \(t \div 4\) as a fraction.
Write "three lots of \(n\)" in algebraic notation.
Write "the square of \(x\)" in algebraic notation.
Write \(7 \times c \times d\) without multiplication signs.
Write \(y + y + y + y + y\) using a coefficient.
Write \(4 \times y \times y\) in correct algebraic notation.
Write \(3 \times a \div b\) in correct algebraic notation.
Write the product of \(7\) and \((x + 2)\) in correct algebraic notation.
Translate "\(y\) less than \(x\)" into algebraic notation.
A student writes \(y3\) to mean three times \(y\). Write this correctly and state the convention they broke.
A student writes \(ba\) for the product of \(a\) and \(b\). Rewrite it in standard form and name the convention.
Write "\(6\) divided by \(n\)" in algebraic notation.
Write \(2 \times p \times p \times p\) in correct algebraic notation.
Write \(a \times a \times b\) in correct algebraic notation.
Translate "\(5\) more than the product of \(3\) and \(k\)" into algebraic notation.
Write \(2 \times a \times 3 \times b\) as simply as possible, justifying each step.
The expression \(5a^{2}b\) is written in correct notation. Write it out fully as a product of separate factors.
Are \(3a^{2}\) and \((3a)^{2}\) the same? Write each as a product and give the correct simplified form of \((3a)^{2}\).
A student writes \(b2a \times c\) to mean two times \(a\), times \(b\), times \(c\). Rewrite it correctly and name every convention used.
Translate into correct notation: "the square of \(x\), divided by \(2y\)".
Write \(p \times p \times q \times p \times q\) in correct algebraic notation.
Translate into correct notation: "add \(4\) to \(n\), then multiply the result by \(m\)".
Two students write the same answer as \(\dfrac{ab}{2}\) and \(\dfrac{1}{2}ab\). Are these the same? Write the expression as a product to decide.

ga02.questionText: State whether \(3x + 5\) is an expression, an equation, a formula or an identity.
State whether \(2x - 7 = 11\) is an expression, an equation, a formula or an identity.
State whether \(A = \ell w\) is an expression, an equation, a formula or an identity.
State whether \(2(x + 4) \equiv 2x + 8\) is an expression, an equation, a formula or an identity.
State whether \(3x + 1 > 10\) is an expression, an equation, a formula or an identity.
How many terms are there in the expression \(4x + 3y - 7\)?
Write down the coefficient of \(x\) in the expression \(7x - 2\).
Write down the coefficient of \(x\) in the expression \(7 - 3x\).
Write down the constant term in the expression \(5x^{2} + 2x - 9\).
True or false: an expression can be solved to find the value of the letter.
How many terms are there in the expression \(8\)?
State whether \(x^{2} - 5x + 6\) is an expression, an equation, a formula or an identity.
By testing the values \(x = 0\) and \(x = 1\), decide whether \(3(x + 2) = 3x + 6\) is an equation or an identity.
By testing the values \(x = 0\) and \(x = 2\), decide whether \(3(x + 2) = 12\) is an equation or an identity.
For the expression \(6x^{2} - 4x + 9\), write down (a) the coefficient of \(x^{2}\), (b) the coefficient of \(x\), and (c) the constant term.
State whether \(v = u + at\) is an expression, an equation, a formula or an identity, and explain why.
State whether \(A = \pi r^{2}\) is an expression, an equation, a formula or an identity, and explain why.
List all the positive factors of the term \(6xy\) (include numerical and letter factors).
State whether \(5x + 2 = 5x + 7\) is an equation that can be solved or has no solution, and explain what this tells you about whether it is an identity.
In the expression \(\dfrac{x}{4} + 9 - 2x\), what is the coefficient of \(x\) in the first term \(\dfrac{x}{4}\)?
State whether \(2x + 3y \le 12\) is an expression, an equation, a formula, an identity or an inequality, and explain how you can tell.
A student writes: 'In \(9 - 4x\), the coefficient of \(x\) is 4.' Explain the mistake and give the correct coefficient.
Explain, by substituting two different values of \(x\), why \(2(x + 3) \equiv 2x + 6\) is an identity but \(2(x + 3) = 10\) is an equation.
Explain in full sentences the difference between a formula and an equation, giving one example of each.

Classify each item in this list as an expression, equation, formula, identity or inequality: (a) \(4x - 1\); (b) \(P = 2(\ell + w)\); (c) \(x^{2} \equiv x \cdot x\); (d) \(5x = 20\); (e) \(x + 3 < 9\).
Is \((x + 1)^{2} = x^{2} + 2x + 1\) true for all values of \(x\)? Justify your answer by testing \(x = 3\) and \(x = -2\), and state what kind of statement it is.
Explain in full sentences the difference between an expression and an equation, and explain why it makes no sense to 'solve' an expression.
A student claims \(3(x + 4) = 3x + 12\) is an equation because it has an equals sign. Explain why it is better described as an identity, and how it could be written more precisely.
For the expression \(7 - \dfrac{x}{2} + 4x^{3}\), state the number of terms, the coefficient of \(x\), the coefficient of \(x^{3}\) and the constant term.
Decide whether \(x + x \equiv x^{2}\) is a correct identity. Justify your answer by testing \(x = 2\) and \(x = 3\), and state correctly what kind of statement it really is.

ga03.questionText: Work out the value of \(3x + 2\) when \(x = 4\).
Work out the value of \(5a - 1\) when \(a = 6\).
Work out the value of \(\dfrac{x}{2} + 3\) when \(x = 10\).
The perimeter of a square is given by \(P = 4s\), where \(s\) is the side length. Find \(P\) when \(s = 7\,\mathrm{cm}\).
Work out the value of \(2x + 5\) when \(x = 9\).
Work out the value of \(10 - 2y\) when \(y = 3\).
Work out the value of \(x^2\) when \(x = 6\).
Work out the value of \(\dfrac{a + b}{2}\) when \(a = 8\) and \(b = 6\).
Work out the value of \(4x - 3\) when \(x = 2.5\).
The cost in pounds of hiring a tool is \(C = 5d + 12\), where \(d\) is the number of days. Find the cost when \(d = 4\).
Work out the value of \(x^2 + x\) when \(x = 5\).
The area of a rectangle is \(A = l w\). Find the area when \(l = 9\,\mathrm{cm}\) and \(w = 4\,\mathrm{cm}\).
Work out the value of \(x^2 - 4x\) when \(x = -3\).
Work out the value of \(2a + 3b\) when \(a = 5\) and \(b = -2\).
Use \(v = u + at\) to find \(v\) when \(u = 3\), \(a = 4\) and \(t = 5\).
The area of a circle is \(A = \pi r^2\). Find the exact area when \(r = 5\,\mathrm{cm}\), leaving your answer in terms of \(\pi\).
Work out the value of \(\dfrac{a + b}{a - b}\) when \(a = 7\) and \(b = 3\).
Speed is given by \(\text{speed} = \dfrac{\text{distance}}{\text{time}}\). A car travels \(150\,\mathrm{km}\) in \(2.5\,\mathrm{hours}\). Find its average speed in \(\mathrm{km\,h^{-1}}\).
Work out the value of \(3x^2 - 2x + 1\) when \(x = 4\).
Compare \((-4)^2\) and \(-4^2\). Write down the value of \((-4)^2 + (-4^2)\).
Work out the value of \(\dfrac{1}{2}(a + b)h\) (the area of a trapezium) when \(a = 6\), \(b = 10\) and \(h = 4\).
Work out the value of \(2x^2 + 3x\) when \(x = -2\).
Use \(s = ut + \dfrac{1}{2}at^2\) to find \(s\) when \(u = 8\), \(a = -10\) and \(t = 3\).
The formula \(F = \dfrac{9}{5}C + 32\) converts Celsius to Fahrenheit. Find \(F\) when \(C = 20\).
The kinetic energy of an object is \(E = \dfrac{1}{2}mv^2\). Find \(E\) (in joules) when \(m = 4\,\mathrm{kg}\) and \(v = 6\,\mathrm{m\,s^{-1}}\).
Work out the value of \(x^3 - 2x^2\) when \(x = -3\).
In the lens formula \(\dfrac{1}{u} + \dfrac{1}{v}\), find the value when \(u = 4\) and \(v = 12\). Give your answer as a fraction in its simplest form.
Work out the value of \(\dfrac{a^2 - b^2}{a + b}\) when \(a = 5\) and \(b = 2\).
The volume of a cone is \(V = \dfrac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\). Find \(V\) when \(r = 3\), \(h = 7\) and \(\pi = 3\) (a rough approximation).
Work out the value of \(\dfrac{2p^2 - q}{p + q}\) when \(p = -2\) and \(q = 4\).

ga04.questionText: A rectangle has length \((3x + 2y)\) and width \((x + 4y)\). Write a fully simplified expression for its perimeter.

The perimeter of a triangle is \(9x + 5\). Two of its sides are \((2x + 3)\) and \((4x - 1)\). Find a fully simplified expression for the length of the third side.

ga05.questionText: The perimeter of a rectangle is given by \(P = 2\big(3x + 5\big) + 2\big(2x - 1\big)\). Expand and simplify to find \(P\) in its simplest form.

Use the difference of two squares to evaluate \(103^2 - 97^2\) without a calculator.
Decide whether \(x^2 + 25\) can be factorised over the real numbers. Explain your answer.
Use the difference of two squares to evaluate \(85^2 - 15^2\) without a calculator.
Use the difference of two squares to show that \(1000^2 - 999^2\) equals the sum \(1000 + 999\), and hence state its value.
Work out the exact value of \(\dfrac{124^2 - 76^2}{124 - 76}\) without a calculator.
Simplify \(\dfrac{x^2 - 49}{x + 7}\), stating any value of \(x\) for which it is not defined.

The area of a square of side \(a\,\text{cm}\) is reduced by cutting away a smaller square of side \(b\,\text{cm}\) from a corner. Given \(a = 6.5\) and \(b = 3.5\), use the difference of two squares to find the remaining area in \(\text{cm}^2\).

Write \(\dfrac{2}{x - 3} + \dfrac{5}{x^2 - 9}\) as a single fraction in its simplest form.
Write \(\dfrac{x + 4}{x^2 - 4} - \dfrac{2}{x + 2}\) as a single fraction in its simplest form.
Write \(\dfrac{3}{x - 1} - \dfrac{2}{x^2 - 1}\) as a single fraction in its simplest form.
Write \(\dfrac{x + 1}{x^2 + 5x + 6} + \dfrac{2}{x + 2}\) as a single fraction in its simplest form.

ga14.questionText: A rectangle has length \(l\) and width \(w\). Write a formula for its perimeter \(P\).
Pens cost \(£3\) each. Write a formula for the total cost \(C\), in pounds, of buying \(n\) pens.
The area of a rectangle is \(A = lw\). Find \(A\) when \(l = 8\,\mathrm{cm}\) and \(w = 5\,\mathrm{cm}\).
Sam is \(y\) years old. His sister is \(4\) years older than Sam. Write a formula for his sister's age \(S\).
The area of a triangle is \(A = \dfrac{1}{2}bh\). Find \(A\) when \(b = 10\,\mathrm{cm}\) and \(h = 6\,\mathrm{cm}\).
Apples cost \(£2\) each. There is a fixed delivery charge of \(£5\). Write a formula for the total cost \(C\), in pounds, of buying \(n\) apples with delivery.
The perimeter of a square is \(P = 4s\). A square has perimeter formula used with \(s = 9\,\mathrm{cm}\). Find \(P\).
A plumber charges a \(£40\) call-out fee plus \(£25\) for each hour worked. Write a formula for the total charge \(C\), in pounds, for \(h\) hours of work.
Using the plumber's formula \(C = 25h + 40\), find the total charge for \(h = 3\) hours of work.
Speed is given by \(\text{speed} = \dfrac{\text{distance}}{\text{time}}\). A runner covers \(40\,\mathrm{m}\) in \(8\,\mathrm{s}\). Find the speed in \(\mathrm{m\,s^{-1}}\).

A pattern is made from matchsticks. The \(n\)th shape uses \(3\) matchsticks for the first square and \(2\) more for each extra square. Write a formula for the number of matchsticks \(M\) in the \(n\)th shape.
The volume of a cube is \(V = s^3\). Find \(V\) when \(s = 4\,\mathrm{cm}\).
A taxi charges a fixed fee of \(£3.50\) plus \(£1.20\) for each mile travelled. Write a formula for the fare \(F\), in pounds, for a journey of \(m\) miles.
Using the taxi formula \(F = 1.2m + 3.5\), find the fare for a journey of \(m = 12\) miles.
Use \(v = u + at\) to find \(v\) when \(u = 12\), \(a = -3\) and \(t = 4\).
The circumference of a circle is \(C = 2\pi r\). Find the exact circumference when \(r = 7\,\mathrm{cm}\), leaving your answer in terms of \(\pi\).

A taxi firm A charges \(£2\) plus \(£3\) per mile. A rival firm B charges \(£8\) plus \(£1\) per mile. Write a single expression for how much more firm A charges than firm B for a journey of \(m\) miles.
The area of a trapezium is \(A = \dfrac{1}{2}(a + b)h\). Find \(A\) when \(a = 5\), \(b = 9\) and \(h = 6\).
A right-angled triangle has the two shorter sides \(a = 6\) and \(b = 8\). Use \(c^2 = a^2 + b^2\) to find the hypotenuse \(c\).
A recipe for \(4\) people uses \(g = 50p\) grams of flour, where \(p\) is the number of people. How many grams of flour are needed for \(p = 10\) people?
The cost in pounds of a gym membership is \(C = 30 + 4.5w\), where \(w\) is the number of weeks. Find the cost for \(w = 8\) weeks.
The \(n\)th term of a sequence is found by multiplying the position by \(5\) and then subtracting \(2\). Write a formula for the \(n\)th term \(T\), and hence state \(T\) when \(n = 1\).
Tariff A for a phone costs \(£10\) plus \(5\)p per minute. Tariff B costs \(£18\) plus \(1\)p per minute. For how many minutes \(m\) do the two tariffs cost the same? (Work in pence.)
The kinetic energy of an object is \(E = \dfrac{1}{2}mv^2\). Find \(E\) (in joules) when \(m = 5\,\mathrm{kg}\) and \(v = 8\,\mathrm{m\,s^{-1}}\).
A van hire firm charges a fixed fee of \(£F\) plus \(£d\) per day. Hiring for \(5\) days costs \(£F + 5d\). Write a simplified formula for the average cost per day, \(A\), of a \(5\)-day hire.
Use \(s = ut + \dfrac{1}{2}at^2\) to find \(s\) when \(u = 5\), \(a = -2\) and \(t = 4\).
A square of side \(x\) has a smaller square of side \(2\) removed from one corner. Write a simplified formula for the remaining area \(A\).
The cost in pounds of printing \(n\) leaflets is \(C = 0.04n + 15\). A customer pays \(£75\). Using the formula, find how many leaflets \(n\) were printed.
The surface area of a closed cylinder is \(S = 2\pi r^2 + 2\pi r h\). Taking \(\pi = 3\) (a rough approximation), find \(S\) when \(r = 2\) and \(h = 5\).
A delivery company charges \(C = 6 + 0.5(w - 1)\) pounds for a parcel of weight \(w\) kilograms, where \(w \ge 1\). Find the charge for a parcel weighing \(w = 13\,\mathrm{kg}\).

ga17.questionText: Is \(2x + 3x = 5x\) an equation or an identity? Explain your choice.
Is \(3x - 1 = 8\) an equation or an identity? Explain your choice.
Is \(4(x + 2) \equiv 4x + 8\) an equation or an identity? Explain your choice.
Is \(A = \pi r^2\) an equation, an identity or a formula? Explain your choice.
Is \((x + 1)^2 \equiv x^2 + 2x + 1\) an equation or an identity? Explain your choice.
Is \(x + 4 = 10\) an equation or an identity? Explain your choice.
Is \(x + x + x \equiv 3x\) an equation or an identity? Explain your choice.
The statement \(5x = 20\) is true for one value of \(x\) only. What is that value?
Complete the identity \(4x + 8 \equiv 4(x + \square)\) by finding the missing number.
Is \(2x - 5 = x + 1\) an equation or an identity? Explain your choice.
Complete the identity \(3x + 12 \equiv 3(x + \square)\) by finding the missing number.
Decide whether \(x^2 = 9\) is true for all values of \(x\) or only some. State whether it is an equation or an identity.
Find the value of \(a\) so that \(a(x + 3) \equiv 5x + 15\) is an identity.
Find the values of \(a\) and \(b\) so that \(3(x + 2) \equiv ax + b\) is an identity.
Find the value of \(c\) so that \(x^2 + 6x + c \equiv (x + 3)^2\) is an identity.
Find the values of \(p\) and \(q\) so that \(2(x - 4) + 3 \equiv px + q\) is an identity.
Show that \(2(3x + 1) - (x - 4) \equiv 5x + 6\) is an identity by expanding and by checking two values of \(x\).
Find the values of \(a\) and \(b\) so that \(a(x + 1) + b(x - 1) \equiv 5x + 1\) is an identity.
Complete the identity \(x^2 + 8x + 20 \equiv (x + 4)^2 + \square\) by finding the missing number.
Decide whether \(3(2x - 1) = 6x - 1\) is an equation or an identity. Justify your answer.
Find the values of \(a\) and \(b\) so that \((x + a)^2 \equiv x^2 + 10x + b\) is an identity.
Find the value of \(k\) so that \(\dfrac{6x + 9}{3} \equiv 2x + k\) is an identity.
Find the values of \(a\), \(b\) and \(c\) so that \(2(x + 1)^2 + 3 \equiv ax^2 + bx + c\) is an identity.
Find the values of \(a\) and \(b\) so that \((2x + a)(x + 3) \equiv 2x^2 + bx + 12\) is an identity.
Find the values of \(a\), \(b\) and \(c\) so that \(x^2 + 6x + 11 \equiv a(x + b)^2 + c\) is an identity.
Find the values of \(A\) and \(B\) so that \(\dfrac{5x + 1}{(x + 1)(x - 1)} \equiv \dfrac{A}{x + 1} + \dfrac{B}{x - 1}\) is an identity.
Find the value of \(k\) for which \(k(x + 2) - 3(x - 1) \equiv x + 11\) is an identity, and explain why the constant terms then match automatically.
Explain why \((x + 2)(x - 2) = x^2 - 5\) cannot be an identity, and state the value(s) of \(x\) for which it is true.
Find the values of \(a\), \(b\) and \(c\) so that \(x^3 + 1 \equiv (x + 1)(x^2 + ax + b) + c\) is an identity.
The statement \(a(x - 1)^2 + b(x - 1) + c \equiv 2x^2 - 3x + 5\) is an identity. Find \(a\), \(b\) and \(c\).

ga18.questionText: The sum of two consecutive odd numbers can be written as \((2n + 1) + (2n + 3)\). Prove that this is identically \(4(n + 1)\), and hence that the sum is always a multiple of 4.

Two consecutive even numbers can be written as \(2n\) and \(2n + 2\). Prove that the difference of their squares, \((2n + 2)^2 - (2n)^2\), is identically \(4(2n + 1)\), and hence is always a multiple of 4.

ga19.questionText: A function is defined by \(f(x) = 2x + 3\). Work out \(f(4)\).
A function is defined by \(g(x) = 5x - 2\). Work out \(g(3)\).
A function is defined by \(f(x) = 7 - x\). Work out \(f(2)\).
A number machine takes an input, multiplies it by \(3\), then adds \(1\). The input is \(5\). What is the output?
A function is defined by \(f(x) = x^2 - 3x\). Work out \(f(-2)\).
A function is defined by \(g(x) = 4x + 5\). Work out \(g\left(\dfrac{1}{2}\right)\).
A function is defined by \(h(x) = 2x^2 + 1\). Work out \(h(-3)\).
A function is defined by \(f(x) = 10 - x^2\). Work out \(f(2.5)\).
A function is defined by \(f(x) = 2x + 3\). Solve \(f(x) = 11\).
A function is defined by \(g(x) = 5x - 4\). Solve \(g(x) = 26\).
A function is defined by \(f(x) = \dfrac{x}{2} + 7\). Solve \(f(x) = 12\).
A function is defined by \(f(x) = 3x - 1\). Work out the value of \(f(2) + f(5)\).
A function is defined by \(f(x) = x^2 + 4x\). Work out \(f(3) - f(-1)\).
A number machine takes an input, subtracts \(2\), then multiplies the result by \(4\). Write the function \(f(x)\) for this machine.
A function is defined by \(f(x) = \dfrac{12}{x} + 1\). Work out \(f(4)\).
A function is defined by \(f(x) = 2x + 9\). Solve \(f(x) = 3\).
A function is defined by \(g(x) = x^2 - 5\). Work out \(g(0.4)\). Give your answer as a decimal.
A function machine has input \(x\), squares it, then subtracts \(7\), giving the function \(f(x) = x^2 - 7\). The output is \(9\). Given that the input is positive, find the input.
A function is defined by \(f(x) = 3x - 5\). Find an expression for \(f(2x)\), giving your answer in its simplest form.
A function is defined by \(f(x) = 2x + 1\). Find an expression for \(f(x + 3)\), giving your answer in its simplest form.
A function is defined by \(f(x) = x^2 + 2\). Find an expression for \(f(x - 1)\), giving your answer in its simplest form.
A function is defined by \(f(x) = ax + 3\). Given that \(f(2) = 11\), find the value of \(a\).
A function is defined by \(f(x) = x^2 + bx\). Given that \(f(3) = 24\), find the value of \(b\).
A function is defined by \(f(x) = x^2 - 2x\). Solve \(f(x) = 8\).
A function is defined by \(f(x) = 4x - 1\). Work out \(f(5) - 2f(2)\).
Two functions are defined by \(f(x) = 3x + 2\) and \(g(x) = x^2 - 1\). Work out \(f(4) + g(-3)\).
A function is defined by \(f(x) = ax^2 + b\). Given that \(f(0) = 5\) and \(f(2) = 17\), find the values of \(a\) and \(b\).
A function is defined by \(f(x) = \dfrac{20}{x} - 3\). Solve \(f(x) = 2\).
A function is defined by \(f(x) = 5 - 2x\). Show that \(f(x + 4) = -2x - 3\).
A function is defined by \(f(x) = 3x - 4\). Find the value of \(x\) for which \(f(x) = x\) (the input equals the output).

ga20.questionText: Find the inverse function \(f^{-1}(x)\) for \(f(x) = x + 7\).
Find the inverse function \(f^{-1}(x)\) for \(f(x) = 7 - x\).
\(f(x) = 3x + 2\). By rearranging, find \(f^{-1}(x)\), and verify that \(f\big(f^{-1}(x)\big) = x\).
Find the inverse function \(f^{-1}(x)\) for \(f(x) = x^2\), where \(x \geq 0\).
Find the inverse function \(f^{-1}(x)\) for \(f(x) = x^2 + 4\), where \(x \geq 0\).
Find the inverse function \(f^{-1}(x)\) for \(f(x) = (x - 1)^2\), where \(x \geq 1\).
Find the inverse function \(f^{-1}(x)\) for \(f(x) = (x + 3)^2 - 5\), where \(x \geq -3\).
Find the inverse function \(f^{-1}(x)\) for \(f(x) = \sqrt{x - 3}\), where \(x \geq 3\).
Find the inverse function \(f^{-1}(x)\) for \(f(x) = 2x^2 - 8\), where \(x \geq 0\).
The functions are \(f(x) = 3x + 1\) and \(g(x) = \dfrac{x - 4}{2}\). Find the value of \(x\) for which \(f^{-1}(x) = g(x)\).

Given \(f(x)=3x-2\) and \(g(x)=x+5\), find \(fg(4)\).
Given \(f(x)=x-3\) and \(g(x)=2x\), find \(ff(10)\).

Given \(f(x)=x^2-1\) and \(g(x)=4x+3\), find \(fg(2)\). Compare your answer with \(gf(2)\).
Given \(f(x)=x+4\), find an expression for \(ff(x)\).
Given \(f(x)=3x\), find an expression for \(ff(x)\).
Given \(f(x)=2x-5\), find and simplify an expression for \(ff(x)\).
Given \(f(x)=x^2\) and \(g(x)=x-3\), find and simplify an expression for \(fg(x)\).
Given \(f(x)=x^2\) and \(g(x)=x-3\), find and simplify an expression for \(gf(x)\), and state whether \(fg(x)=gf(x)\).

Given \(f(x)=\dfrac{12}{x}\) and \(g(x)=x+1\), find an expression for \(fg(x)\).
Given \(f(x)=4x+1\) and \(g(x)=2x-3\), solve \(fg(x)=29\).

Given \(f(x)=x^2+1\), find and simplify an expression for \(ff(x)\).
Given \(f(x)=x^2\) and \(g(x)=x-2\), solve \(fg(x)=9\).

Given \(f(x)=2x+1\) and \(g(x)=x^2\), solve \(fg(x)=gf(x)\).
Given \(f(x)=x+3\) and \(g(x)=x^2-2x\), solve \(gf(x)=0\).
Given \(f(x)=2x-1\), \(g(x)=x+4\) and \(h(x)=x^2\), find and simplify an expression for \(fgh(x)\).
The functions \(f\) and \(g\) satisfy \(g(x)=x-2\) and \(fg(x)=3x+1\). Find \(f(x)\), then evaluate \(f(5)\).
Given \(f(x)=x^2-5\) and \(g(x)=x+1\), solve \(fg(x)=11\).
Given \(f(x)=\dfrac{x}{x+1}\), find and simplify an expression for \(ff(x)\).
Given \(f(x)=2x+5\) and \(g(x)=x^2-3\), solve \(gf(x)=fg(x)\).

ga22.questionText: State the coordinates of the point \(P\) which is \(3\) units to the right of the origin and \(2\) units up.
In which quadrant does the point \((-4,\,-1)\) lie? Give your answer as the quadrant number (\(1\), \(2\), \(3\) or \(4\)).
Find the midpoint of the line segment joining \((2,\,4)\) and \((6,\,8)\).
The point \((3,\,5)\) is reflected in the \(x\)-axis. State the coordinates of its image.
Find the midpoint of the line segment joining \(A(-3,\,2)\) and \(B(5,\,-4)\).
Find the distance between \((1,\,2)\) and \((4,\,6)\).
The point \((-2,\,7)\) is reflected in the \(y\)-axis. State the coordinates of its image.
The midpoint of \(A(2,\,3)\) and \(B\) is \(M(5,\,7)\). Find the coordinates of \(B\).
Three vertices of a rectangle are \(A(1,\,1)\), \(B(5,\,1)\) and \(C(5,\,4)\). Find the coordinates of the fourth vertex \(D\).
Find the midpoint of the line segment joining \((-6,\,-2)\) and \((-1,\,5)\). Give each coordinate as a fraction where necessary.
Find the distance between \((-2,\,1)\) and \((3,\,13)\).
Three vertices of a parallelogram, taken in order, are \(P(0,\,0)\), \(Q(4,\,1)\) and \(R(6,\,5)\). Find the coordinates of the fourth vertex \(S\) so that \(PQRS\) is a parallelogram.
The point \(A(-4,\,6)\) is reflected in the \(x\)-axis to give \(A'\), and then \(A'\) is reflected in the \(y\)-axis to give \(A''\). Find the coordinates of \(A''\).
\(M(2,\,-1)\) is the midpoint of \(PQ\), where \(P=(-3,\,4)\). Find the coordinates of \(Q\).
A line segment runs from \(A(-5,\,2)\) to \(B(7,\,2)\). A point \(C\) lies on \(AB\) such that \(AC:CB = 1:3\). Find the coordinates of \(C\).
Find the distance between \((-3,\,-2)\) and \((1,\,1)\).

On a coordinate grid, point \(P\) is in the fourth quadrant, \(2\) units below the \(x\)-axis and \(5\) units to the right of the \(y\)-axis. State the coordinates of \(P\), and the coordinates of its reflection \(P'\) in the \(y\)-axis. Give your answer as the pair \((P,\,P')\).

The diagonals of a parallelogram bisect each other. A parallelogram has vertices \(A(-2,\,1)\), \(B(4,\,3)\), \(C(6,\,-1)\) and \(D\), where \(AC\) and \(BD\) are the diagonals. Find the coordinates of \(D\).
Find the exact distance between \((-4,\,3)\) and \((2,\,-1)\), giving your answer as a simplified surd.
A line segment from \(A(-3,\,-4)\) to \(B(9,\,8)\) is divided by a point \(P\) such that \(AP:PB = 2:1\). Find the coordinates of \(P\).
\(A(1,\,2)\) and \(C(7,\,10)\) are opposite corners of a square \(ABCD\) (vertices in order). Find the coordinates of \(B\) and \(D\). Give your answer as the pair \((B,\,D)\).
\(M(1,\,-2)\) is the midpoint of \(AB\). Given that \(A\) lies on the \(y\)-axis and \(B\) lies on the \(x\)-axis, find the coordinates of \(A\) and \(B\). Give your answer as the pair \((A,\,B)\).
A triangle has vertices \(A(-2,\,1)\), \(B(4,\,1)\) and \(C(1,\,5)\). Show whether the triangle is isosceles by comparing side lengths, and state the length of the side \(AB\).

Three vertices of a parallelogram are \(P(-1,\,2)\), \(Q(3,\,-1)\) and \(R(6,\,4)\). There are three possible positions for the fourth vertex. Find the position \(S\) for which \(PQRS\) (in that order) is a parallelogram.
\(B\) is the midpoint of \(AC\). Given \(A(-5,\,8)\) and that the midpoint of \(AB\) is \((-2,\,5)\), find the coordinates of \(C\).
Point \(A=(2,\,-3)\) and point \(B=(t,\,5)\) are a distance of \(10\) units apart, where \(t>0\). Find the value of \(t\).

A line segment from \(A(-7,\,5)\) to \(B(5,\,-7)\) is split into four equal parts by points \(P\), \(Q\) and \(R\) (in order from \(A\)). Find the coordinates of \(Q\), the point exactly halfway along, and of \(P\), the first quarter point.
A rectangle \(ABCD\) (vertices in order) has \(A(-2,\,-1)\), \(B(2,\,1)\) and \(C(0,\,5)\). Find the coordinates of \(D\), and verify that \(ABCD\) has a right angle at \(B\).
Points \(A(-6,\,3)\) and \(B(6,\,-1)\) are given. Find the point \(C\) on segment \(AB\) with \(AC:CB=3:1\), then state the midpoint of \(CB\).
A triangle has vertices \(A(0,\,0)\), \(B(6,\,0)\) and \(C(0,\,8)\). Find the distance from the right-angle vertex \(A\) to the midpoint of the hypotenuse \(BC\), and comment on what you notice.

ga23.questionText: The line has equation \(y = x + 3\). Complete the table of values by finding \(y\) when \(x = 2\).
